elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must indemnify and hold harmless, but the clause contains no express duty to defend Client or its affiliates.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: TrueLink indemnifies Client and its affiliates against “all claims,” which encompasses third-party claims.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Clause b(ii) covers allegations that the Interface, Hosting Services, Support Services, or other TrueLink materials or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Clause b(iii) expressly covers TrueLink's breach of applicable law, rule, or regulation.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Clause b(iv) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Clause b(v) expressly covers TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: No provision allocates control of the defense.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Client's indemnity also covers any breach of the Agreement, acts or omissions causing TrueLink defaults, and injury or property damage involving items distributed from the Web Site.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: TrueLink indemnifies Client against all claims arising from allegations that specified TrueLink services, materials, or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-modification exclusion is present, so the indemnity is broader than the permitted exclusion.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No Customer-combination exclusion is present, so the indemnity is broader than the permitted exclusion.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion is present, so the indemnity is broader than the permitted exclusion.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no obligation to procure continued use, modify, or replace an infringing item.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no refund remedy or trigger based on the unavailability of other IP remedies.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
